column1: # Ash Jenna, an antagonist, confronts the party in Tolbi after Colosso.

column3:
You remember what I said
in Lamakan. The sleepers
are stirring here, too.{page_break}Listen to the harbor,
Isaac. The sea has begun
to answer them.{end_wait}
Ash Jenna. We know what\nyou told us in Lamakan.\nWhy are you here?{end_wait}

I am watching what wakes
when the next lighthouse
is lit.{page_break}You cannot save every
soul that hears the call,
no matter how you try.{end_wait}
You said the lighthouses\nwake the sleepers. Is this\nwhat is happening here?{end_wait}
You are learning, Garet.\nBut understanding the\nthreat will not stop it.{end_wait}
You came to frighten us.\nWe won't leave people to\nface this alone.{end_wait}
Still defending everyone,\nMia? You admitted you\nwanted the beast to suffer.{end_wait}
I was angry. I won't deny\nit. But you don't get to\nturn that into my nature.{end_wait}

Light the next lighthouse,
Isaac. More will wake, and
the voices will spread.{page_break}You may keep answering
them, but you cannot be
everywhere at once.{end_wait}
Wait! What is happening\nto the people at the\nharbor?{end_wait}
